text_block_list.text: I ran into a flustered Rine Kraft and Cesario, who was comforting her.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fueeehn... A makeup exam...?
And if I don't pass, remedial classes too?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer.
Actually... yes...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: How about we all have a study session together? As long as you pass the makeup exam, you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, thank you~...
I'll do my best!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Is the subject math? Let's do our best, Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, with us as your teachers,
we'll have you passing those makeup exams in no time!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!! Thank youuu~~!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's get started. Study session time!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu... There are so many formulas...
I can't memorize them all...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I see... In that case...
Yes, let's head out to a more open area."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we do a light dance?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: U-Um? Dance? But why... !?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Moving your muscles increases blood flow to the brain.
When your brain is active, your focus and thinking power naturally improve.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: It's especially effective for memorization. It's backed by research, and it's a method I use often myself. Let's try♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Craft, let's give it a shot.
We'll do it together with you.

text_block_list.name: Craft & Cesario
text_block_list.text: y=ax！　y=a/x！！

text_block_list.name: Craft & Messiah
text_block_list.text: y=ax+b！　y=ax^2！！

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just like that.
Five, six, seven, eight!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's try using the formulas you just learned.
I've gathered some recommended workbooks for you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? All these workbooks!?
There are over ten of them!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I see. There are plenty of basic exercises.
Do all these, and your foundation will be solid for sure!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: If there's anything you don't understand, feel free to ask me anytime.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Round and round~~ My head's gonna explode~...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Here, drink this and calm down.
It's hot milk.
—And coffee for you two.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you. No sugar, just milk.
Exactly how I like it! As expected of you, Cesario♪"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I prepared all the snacks everyone likes too.
Once we've taken a break, let's give it our all again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! ...Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...? What's the matter, Craft?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... It somehow made me feel happy.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's supposed to be exhausting...
I find myself loving this time together.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
All the more reason to pass quickly, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Time is precious, so I can't have you wasting it on remedial lessons.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah!
Because I want to run with everyone as soon as I can—!
A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaann!!
I did it! I passed the makeup exam!
choice_data_list: Glad we could get that solved so quickly!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-saaann!!
I did it! I passed the makeup exam!
choice_data_list: Glad we could get that solved so quickly!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We worked so hard together that
I truly believed there was no way I couldn't do it—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Even during the test, I remembered us dancing together and chuckled a bit... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Having study sessions together, memorizing formulas...
I don't think I'll ever forget any of it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to the dependable teachers.
They were truly a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Though I really don't want to look
at that mountain of workbooks for a while...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So I don't cause trouble for everyone, I decided
I need to study really hard too...!
